outcome.text: 李昂和克莱尔沿维修通道潜行至实验档案室。李昂插入门禁卡，锁舌咔哒一声回响，金属门缓缓滑开。室内弥漫着陈旧的化学味，荧光灯闪烁不定。满架的文件柜和翻倒的实验记录表明这里曾是混乱的现场。李昂走向主终端，克莱尔则侧面留意走廊。终端屏幕亮起，显示登录提示。李昂输入凭证，档案开始卷动。监控录像和实验日志逐条呈现，李昂仔细浏览每一条条目，试图寻找Victor是否在事故前隐瞒了什么。

Emergency lights flicker overhead, casting a dim yellow glow over Leon's rain-soaked face. He wipes his face and follows Claire to a long table piled high with files. Faint metallic footsteps echo in the distance. Both pause briefly, then focus intently on searching through the documents. Claire pulls up a stack of yellowed experiment records, her brow furrowing tighter. Leon leans in, his fingertips tracing the blurred text on the pages. His gaze scans rows of experiment data stained with ink.
